scope: Opportunity review of eleven cantons; no new canton-stop census, geometry adapter or application study.
method: Selected complete agency records and existing route-audit rows copied from the hashed local inputs. Web findings are research observations, not retained raw responses or reproducible HTTP probes. Recommendations are editorial judgements.
limits: Seed agencies are not complete canton membership. Agency counts cover the entire agency footprint, have no geography and count frequency templates once.
Existing route rows describe complete civil-day journeys in the source study; they are not canton totals.
PriorGeometryStatus and priorEvidence are inherited from the 2026-09-08 source survey and were not re-probed here.
No external raw vector exports were acquired. Metadata visibility does not establish redistribution permission.
Working-tree inputs may evolve; the copied evidence and hashes identify the inputs used by this review.

nationalCensus.method: Every agency and route in the archive; calendar plus exceptions on each date. Includes foreign and publication-only records. No stop_times, civil-day clipping, geography, geometry join or headway expansion.
nationalCensus.limits: Agency IDs are feed identities, not a verified list of legal operators or regional membership. URLs and names are preserved verbatim and may be generic or unexpected. Zero active trips means inactive on these dates, not absent year-round.

cantons.relationship: National rail/PostBus methods; no new geometry validation in this review

cantons.name: Schaffhausen

cantons.nextEvidence: Both vbsh identities, separate canton pieces and German road extent

cantons.name: Appenzell Ausserrhoden
cantons.proposal: Appenzeller rail branches and Herisau buses, jointly with AI
cantons.relationship: SG route evidence, subject to source-specific redistribution constraints
cantons.nextEvidence: Independent canton census, Herisau geometry and eastern branches
cantons.priorEvidence: KTAR WMS capabilities checked; no actual public transport line network identified. The regional geodata shop advertises GeoPackage acquisition with registration, but that does not establish a bus dataset. SG subsidised-line coverage cannot be extended to all AR by assumption.

cantons.name: Appenzell Innerrhoden
cantons.proposal: Appenzell–Wasserauen and fixed feeders, jointly with AR
cantons.relationship: AB route evidence; separate explanatory treatment of flexible service
cantons.nextEvidence: Oberegg and mountain scope; no invented PubliCar departures
cantons.priorEvidence: KTAI WMS and official portal checked. Transport-related matches are rail-noise or contaminated-site layers, not passenger service paths. No bus-line export verified. Flexible PubliCar service areas cannot be rendered as fixed scheduled routes.

cantons.name: Neuchâtel
cantons.proposal: Littoral–mountains contrast and Neuchâtel funicular connections
cantons.relationship: New regional composition using national timetable and rail methods
cantons.nextEvidence: SITN line distribution or OSM matching; all transN identities and replacements
cantons.priorEvidence: Public SITN WMS capabilities and services documentation checked. No transport line export verified in that service. Published stop metadata and transport digitisation documentation are leads, not an acquired bus graph. transN spans multiple rail, bus and funicular identities.

cantons.name: Jura
cantons.relationship: National rail/PostBus methods, with BE/SO donor candidates only
cantons.nextEvidence: Moutier in 2026 boundary, raw line export and night-service witnesses
cantons.priorEvidence: WMS advertises ju.sdt_09_07_lignes_de_bus, night-bus and railway layers. WFS does not advertise those transport layers. Bus-layer XML metadata returned, but its distribution links are rendered images; the PDF and geodata-inventory endpoints returned 500.

cantons.name: Basel-Landschaft
cantons.relationship: Extend existing Basel core with a distinct BL coverage report
cantons.nextEvidence: Acquire 41-BL and compare its 2024 geometry against 2026 service
cantons.priorEvidence: TNW/transport Shapefile is advertised in prior official metadata research, but this pass did not acquire the export. Direct metadata request returned 403. The existing Basel audit has stronger evidence for individual BVB/BLT paths, not the whole canton.
